raw_text: Suspected ULFA-I militants sabotaged an Oil India Limited crude oil pipeline in Tinsukia district, Assam on Thursday, using improvised explosive devices placed at two valve stations along the Duliajan-Numaligarh corridor. The attack caused a major oil spill affecting approximately 12 hectares of wetland. ULFA-I claimed responsibility through its official Telegram channel. Security forces have been deployed and the pipeline section has been shut down for repairs.
clean_text: ULFA-I sabotaged OIL pipeline in Tinsukia with IEDs at two valve stations. Major spill affecting 12 hectares. Pipeline shut down, security forces deployed.
